post.title: Wispr Flow wants $15 a month. BetterWispr wants nothing.
post.caption: Four fresh grudges: a dictation subscription, a PDF bill, a seventeen-dollar passport photo and a pile of fake-free office apps, each replaced by someone who refused to pay.
